case_number: Writ Petition (C) No. 243 of 2005; Writ Petition (C) No. 228 of 2006
summary: Accessibility enforcement for persons with disabilities; RPWD Act 2016 compliance failure by states; NALSAR-CDS report submission after delayed implementation of 2017 directives; physical/digital infrastructure accessibility standards; universal design principles; reasonable accommodation mandates; inconsistent legal frameworks identified; monitoring mechanism ordered.
legal_provisions_cited: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016
Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995
final_judgment: Direction issued for compliance with RPWD Act 2016; states/UTs required to implement NALSAR-CDS recommendations; universal accessibility standards to be operationalized across infrastructure sectors.
